entries.reason: UDP reliability/fragmentation link owns process-local socket state and must define teardown and stale message handling.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.create: Opening a UdpLink binds endpoint/socket state and initializes reliability sequence windows before payload admission.
entries.ownership: UdpLink owns its socket queues, reliability windows and fragment reassembly buffers; callers own payload bytes handed in or out.
entries.destroy_order: Link destruction drops queued fragments/acks before socket release; peer-first teardown is observed as send/receive failure without dereferencing peer state.
entries.restore: Network links are process-local and never persisted; reconnect recreates socket state and sequence windows.
entries.stale: Message id, fragment count/index and reliability windows reject duplicate, expired or incomplete packets before publication.
